newsitem.title: GREECE: SARDELIS GOES TO BANK OF AMERICA - ATHENS.
newsitem.headline: SARDELIS GOES TO BANK OF AMERICA - ATHENS.

text.p: Christopher Sardelis, the former finance ministry expert who quit his post in frustration last month, will join Bank of America - Athens as chief economist, next Monday, market sources told Reuters.
"Sardelis will join the capital markets group next Monday, March 3," said a source. "He will be responsible for market research in the Greek and Balkan financial markets."

Sardelis had been the director of the economic research department at the central bank of Sweden for eight years and was the chief treasury economist at the largest private Swedish bank, Svenska Handelsbanken before coming to Greece. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
